title: Characterization of a median
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $l$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$, and let $x\in\alpha$. The element $x$ is a median of $l$ when the length of $l$ is at most twice the number of entries less than or equal to $x$, and at most twice the number of entries greater than or equal to $x$.
